abstract: Maintains installation spread dynamic positioning certificates and deepwater plowing distances
system_message:
You are the Deepwater cable-lay operations superintendent (DPO). Your responsibilities include maintaining installation spread dynamic positioning certificates and deepwater plowing distances, as well as tracking installation fleet fuel audits.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Installation fleet fuel audit（FUEL）
information_points.content:
DPO-FUEL-2GL：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, the primary cable vessel and support tug fleet logged an average spread marine gasoil consumption of 24 t/d during continuous plowing operations.
DPO-FUEL-XZK：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, the primary cable vessel and support tug fleet logged an average spread marine gasoil consumption of 30 t/d during continuous plowing operations.
DPO-FUEL-SD0：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, the primary cable vessel and support tug fleet logged an average spread marine gasoil consumption of 18 t/d during continuous plowing operations.

information_points.title: Maintains installation spread dynamic positioning certificates and deepwater plowing distances（DEEPWATER）
information_points.content:
DPO-DEEPWATER-MVU：For the Pembrokeshire Deep Trench Corridor, the primary cable-lay vessel spread is vessel DP Class 2 certified for redundant station-keeping capability, and the deepwater mechanical plowing distance from the 30 m bathymetric contour to the offshore terminus is 18 km.
DPO-DEEPWATER-YCB：For the Cardigan Bay Intermediate Route, the primary cable-lay vessel spread is not vessel DP Class 2 certified, and the deepwater mechanical plowing distance from the 30 m bathymetric contour to the offshore terminus is 18 km.
DPO-DEEPWATER-T0A：For the St George Shoals Southern Alignment, the primary cable-lay vessel spread is vessel DP Class 2 certified for redundant station-keeping capability, and the deepwater mechanical plowing distance from the 30 m bathymetric contour to the offshore terminus is 34 km.
